$comment: What every hub installs. Local plugins: every folder under the include patterns (plugins/*) that holds a bb plugin, except exclude. Remote plugins: other PUBLIC repositories, installed straight from there ({ "repo": "owner/name or https URL", "path"?: "folder in that repo", "ref"?: "branch/tag/semver:..." }); private repositories are not supported. Marketplace plugins: from bb's marketplaces ({ "id", "marketplace"?, "source"? }). Manage them with bb hub plugin add/remove and bb hub marketplace add/remove. syncIntervalMinutes (5-1440): the shared sync interval; every hub syncs at the same UTC-aligned times.
